name: @solutions-builder/tools-delivery
description: Delivery tools for a specialist's sidecar. publish_workspace is kept for closures that already ship it — no stage deploys it today; stage 8's build runs on the host and the host's build route packages the attempt — and uses the same packaging and checks (@solutions-builder/specialist-runtime/package-attempt). deliver raises the person's acceptance decision at stage 9.
